main.name: Website Building Team
main.heroLine: This website started as one sentence. Here's everything that happened next.
main.shareLine: An AI design studio that shows its work.
main.setupSentence: Set up the website building team from BOOTSTRAP.md.
main.whatHappensNext: Paste it into Claude Code or T3 Code inside the repo. That thread becomes your project manager: it installs the tools, opens five agent threads, and asks what you want to build.
main.gpuNotice: Built for a Windows PC with an NVIDIA graphics card (12 GB). It isn't suited to machines without one.

meta.title: Website Building Team: an AI design studio that shows its work
meta.description: Six agent threads, three creative directions, three coded variations and four human decisions turn one prompt into a launched website. This site is its own case study.
